t: 在扎布之战中,阿巴斯德叛军击败了乌迈亚德·哈里发,导致王朝被推翻.
te: In the Battle of the Zab, the Abbasid rebels defeat the Umayyad Caliphate, leading to the overthrow of the dynasty.
